_comment: Per-document extraction rules for Phase 2. Every deviation from a plain full-document extraction is declared here rather than applied by hand, so that the result is reproducible and every exclusion has a recorded reason (assignment document section 3.2).

CYB-002.reason: Screening decision 7.2: scope limited to Appendices A, B and H. Page positions were verified by hand in a PDF viewer and then confirmed page by page against the extracted text: 31 is Appendix A (terminology), 32-35 are Appendix B (readiness checklist), 41-43 are the prose part of Appendix H (post-incident review). Pages 36-40 and 44-50 are excluded because they are Appendices C to G and the PIR analysis form - blank templates that cannot serve as evidence. Excluding 38-40 also removes a defect: those pages are landscape tables and pdfplumber returns their text character-reversed ('xidneppA' for 'Appendix'). Marker-based slicing was tried first and abandoned because the word 'Appendix' appears throughout the body as cross-references.

CYB-003.reason: Screening decision 7.2: scope limited to Appendices A, B and H. Verified page by page against the extracted text: 29-30 are Appendix A (terminology and definitions), 31-33 are Appendix B (readiness checklist), 40-42 are the prose part of Appendix H (post cybersecurity incident reviews, including the hot debrief and formal debrief guidance). Pages 34-39 and 43-47 are excluded as Appendices C to G and the PIR analysis form. Page numbers are PDF viewer positions, not printed page numbers; the two differ by four in this document.

CYB-004.reason: Screening decision 7.2: Executive Summary and Sections 1-2 only. Section 3 is a CSF reference table unsuitable for semantic chunking; the remainder is references, acronyms and glossary.

DIS-002.reason: Screening risk 7.1: the PDF carries two overlapping text layers. Extraction output must be inspected and the cover panel cleaned before chunking.

DIS-003.reason: 2-page hazard sheet. Source typo 'overpas' is preserved verbatim (screening risk 7.3).

DIS-004.reason: Definitional page giving the four flood alert levels. weather.gov contains no <nav>, <header>, <footer> or <main> elements, so dropping by tag removed nothing and the first extraction carried roughly 140 words of site menu into the corpus. The article is held in '.cms-content'; selecting it directly yields 237 words of body text.

INF-003.reason: Screening risk 7.2: raw extraction returns roughly 2,655 words of which only about 1,782 are article. Navigation must be stripped or chunking will produce dozens of menu-text chunks.

INF-004.start_marker: Staying informed during a power outage
INF-004.reason: Short page. Body content only; the surrounding page furniture changes between saves.
